# `jouet setup`

- **Usage:** `jouet setup [FLAGS] <HARNESS>`

Install jouet's hooks into a coding agent's harness

Merges hooks into Claude Code's settings.json, Codex's hooks.json, Cursor's hooks.json, Gemini CLI's settings.json or Copilot's hooks/jouet.json, keeping every other hook. The session-start hook primes each session with the commands and rules, so the skill, which says the same, is installed only with --skill or when priming is off ([hooks] prime). Running it again changes nothing. The jouet-init project onboarding skill is installed only with --init-skill; --uninstall removes only what jouet added. The hooks do nothing where jouet is not on PATH.

For Claude Code, setup also applies a context budget from your own recent sessions: a compaction window when they run on a 1M-token model, and denying what none of them used. It says what it changed; --undo takes each part back and keeps it back, and --no-context-budget skips both.

## Arguments
- **`<HARNESS>`** — claude, codex, cursor, gemini or copilot

## Flags
- **`--global`** — Install for every project, under your home directory (the default)
- **`--project`** — Install into this repository for you alone: Claude Code's untracked .claude/settings.local.json
- **`--shared`** — Install into the repository's tracked hooks file (.claude/settings.json, .codex/hooks.json, .cursor/hooks.json, .gemini/settings.json or .github/hooks/jouet.json), for everyone who clones it (implies --project)
- **`--dry-run`** — Show what would change without writing anything
- **`--uninstall`** — Remove jouet's hooks and skills
- **`--skill`** — Install the skill as well, which the session-start primer otherwise stands in for
- **`--init-skill`** — Install the jouet-init skill, with which an agent fits jouet to a project's checks
- **`--benchmark`** — Print a prompt for an agent to benchmark jouet on this project
- **`--compact-window <TOKENS>`** — Claude Code: compact a conversation once its context reaches TOKENS (100k to 1m), by setting autoCompactWindow. It pays on a 1M-token model; a 200k one already compacts there
- **`--deny-unused`** — Claude Code: deny the tools and MCP servers that none of your last 50 sessions called, and hide from the model the skills none used (still there as /name)
- **`--undo <CHOICE>`** — Claude Code: take back what --compact-window (window) or --deny-unused (unused) added, and nothing else. A later setup leaves that part alone until its flag asks for it again

  **Choices:** `window`, `unused`
- **`--no-context-budget`** — Claude Code: install without the context budget setup otherwise applies from your recent sessions
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
